evidence.finding: CHM Energy explicitly presents itself as an EV charging operator with more than 100 public/self-service charge points, operating, billing, maintenance and a mobility platform supporting app/RFID/direct payment.
CHM describes configurable billing/payment functionality rather than a single published network-wide tariff.
No current public deterministic station/EVSE -> CPO-direct price grid, QR tariff page, or anonymous tariff resolver was recovered.

decision: active->setAside; first-party operator/network identity is proven, but pricing is configuration-driven and not publicly deterministic. Exact station/EVSE tariff required.
